LR-ASPP with MobileNetV3-Small
==============================

Upstream copyright: Copyright (c) Soumith Chintala 2016
Upstream license: BSD 3-Clause
Upstream source: https://github.com/pytorch/vision/tree/v0.28.0
Checkpoint source: torchvision MobileNet_V3_Small_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1
(https://download.pytorch.org/models/mobilenet_v3_small-047dcff4.pth)

Local modifications: OpenScaner combines torchvision's MobileNetV3-Small
stride-8 and stride-32 feature maps with torchvision's Lite R-ASPP head,
changes the classifier to one binary logit, and trains the complete network on
the shared deterministic generated document dataset. The exported checkpoint
contains the best local validation state.

The verbatim upstream BSD 3-Clause license is packaged at
licenses/BSD-3-Clause-Torchvision.txt.
